flow_scenarios: Neutral (<no signal / spool centered>): main spool 157B7123 in open-neutral position — P connects through to T return rail (open center), A and B ports blocked from load, LS lines see no pressure (LS_A/LS_B relieved to tank via 250 setting cartridges).

Signal <5V (TO STBD): PVEU drives spool so P -> A port -> off to STBD-side actuator (off-sheet via port A branch at top); return flow from B port -> spool -> T rail; LS signal taken from A side path, limited to 250 by LS_A cartridge.

Signal >5V (TO PORT): PVEU drives spool opposite direction so P -> B port -> off to PORT-side actuator (off-sheet via port B branch at top); return flow from A port -> spool -> T rail; LS signal taken from B side path, limited to 250 by LS_B cartridge.
Over-pressure at A port: if A-side load pressure exceeds 280 setting, relief cartridge (157B2280) on A branch opens, dumping A port oil to common P/T rail, protecting actuator/hose on A side.
Over-pressure at B port: if B-side load pressure exceeds 280 setting, relief cartridge (157B2280) on B branch opens, dumping B port oil to common P/T rail, protecting actuator/hose on B side.

flow_scenarios: Neutral (<UNKNOWN exact voltage> at 5V center, open-center spool): P connects through open spool center directly to T, no flow to A or B work ports; LS line stays at low/tank pressure

TO STBD (<5V, spool shifts to A): P -> spool -> A work port supplying stern thruster actuator; return flow from B port -> spool -> T return rail; LS line senses A-port downstream pressure via shuttle/check and reports to pump compensator
TO PORT (>5V, spool shifts to B): P -> spool -> B work port; return flow from A port -> spool -> T return rail; LS line senses B-port downstream pressure via shuttle/check

Overpressure relief event on either work port: if A or B port pressure exceeds the (illegible) relief cartridge setting, that relief opens and dumps excess flow to T return rail, protecting the actuator/line

LS limiter action: LS line pressure signal passes through orifice and check into limiter set at 300 (units illegible); if LS signal exceeds 300 setting, limiter bleeds LS signal to T, capping the pressure command sent upstream to pump compensator
ports: M - gauge/measurement port on left side, tapped off LS/work circuit junction, connects to internal LS sensing branch
LS - load-sense port at bottom left, runs off to left edge (off-sheet) toward pump compensator, part number 157B5111 label on supply line above
T - tank return port at bottom, connects to common return rail (blue dashed line running full height of crop, off-sheet at both ends)
P - pressure inlet port at bottom, connects to supply rail (red dashed line running full height of crop) fed from main pump line labeled 157B5111 at top
A/B work ports - internal to module 11166832, not individually labeled with off-module port callouts in this crop; presumed to run off top edge toward stern thruster actuator (off-sheet)
